evidenceBoundary: Deterministic local repository, real local-Git worktree, temporary SQLite, and synthetic retrieval-corpus tests only. No cloud model, external account, or production task corpus was used.
problemsRecovered: Mission memory marked pre-drift milestone summaries stale on the durable record but still delivered their text to the replanner, making freshness advisory rather than enforced at the prompt boundary.

change.staleMemoryProjection: projectMissionMemoryForPrompt omits entries with stale:true and emits omittedStaleMilestoneSummaryCount. The durable record retains the stale entry for audit; initial planning and replanning receive the projection rather than the raw memory object.

coverage: real repository contradiction invalidates an assumption and replans
external target drift retains stale memory only durably

proven: Mission memory is one-mission, structured, bounded to 16,000 serialized bytes, and retains only public summaries, evidence references, contracts, risks, failures, and steering summaries rather than agent transcripts or private context.
A revision change labels old milestone summaries stale in durable memory while projectMissionMemoryForPrompt removes their text from planning input and records how many were omitted.
Repository evidence that contradicts a planner assumption causes runtime-owned assumption invalidation and a replan; a model cannot self-certify acceptance or rewrite the mission intent.

The seeded repository corpus achieved full expected-file coverage in its top-15 delivered retrieval window, rejects generated/vendor contamination, and refreshes a renamed symbol without leaving its stale target record leading the result.
Context assembly respects tested 16K/32K/64K/128K budgets and protects private role context across mission recovery and steering flows.
notProven: Cross-mission or cross-session task memory, repository memory, execution history, or project/user preferences. Those capabilities are not implemented; mission memory is deliberately scoped to one mission.

Retrieval relevance on a real production task corpus, user-specific preference usefulness, or provider-token cost. The byte cap and synthetic corpus are deterministic proxies, not production measurements.

Mechanical exclusion of every unversioned memory field after repository drift. The enforced projection currently rejects only explicitly revisioned stale milestone summaries; remaining public state stays untrusted and cannot grant completion authority.
requiredNextEvidence: Before adding persistent cross-mission memory, define explicit user ownership, retention, deletion, retrieval relevance, contradiction-resolution, and prompt-cost contracts. Validate them on an authorized anonymized task corpus with a held-out retrieval set and retain redacted route, context-byte, verification, and completion-gate receipts.
